sources.title: Prewar Japanese government cartography of Karafuto and the Kuril Islands in the National Diet Library catalog
sources.coverage: Government-produced survey and hydrographic mapping of southern Sakhalin (Karafuto) and the Kuril Islands before 1945
sources.notes: NDL catalog records identify concrete maps produced by the Karafuto Government, Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department and Navy Hydrographic Department. These records locate the authoritative pre-1945 cartographic corpus but do not themselves authorize automatic production geometry. Exact source sheets must be acquired reproducibly, rights-reviewed where applicable, georeferenced and spatially validated before promotion.
